subject: The 2AM treat that shocked my vet
preview_text: One hidden calorie bomb nearly doubled my dog's daily intake. See yours in 30 seconds.
body_paragraphs: I thought I was being a good dog parent. A tiny training treat here, a bit of peanut butter there. Then my vet pulled out a chart and showed me the math—I was accidentally feeding my pup an extra 400 calories a day. That's like a human eating a whole pizza as a snack.

Turns out, most of us are way off on what our dogs actually need. And the guilt hits hard when you realize you've been the one causing the weight gain. But here's the good news: fixing it takes less time than scrolling social media.

Open PupShape and tap 'Calorie Calculator.' Enter your dog's breed, age, and weight—it takes 30 seconds. You'll immediately see exactly how many calories your pup should get, plus a breakdown of what you're feeding now. It's like having a nutritionist in your pocket, minus the judgment.

Try it right now—just open the app and hit the calculator. See where you stand. P.S. One user found out her 'low-cal' dog biscuits were actually 80 calories each. She switched brands and her dog lost 2 pounds in 3 weeks.
